name: San Vicente del Raspeig (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided green over white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of San Vicente del Raspeig (a crowned shield with the Senyera above a horseshoe and flowers on green).
history: Municipal flag of San Vicente del Raspeig; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: San Vicente del Raspeig arms — Senyera, horseshoe and flowers
